=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:4322-4357 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `augment_files_touched`, the `timed_out` latch (`timed_out = reason == "timeout"` and the `if timed_out:` block) means one issue's selector timeout skips every later issue with `reason=timeout_previous`, even though the time budget is per issue.
  WHY: Issue #8189 says "a timeout ... means a no-op for that issue", so later siblings lose their affected tests and companions, and check-partition / auto_serialize_file_overlaps cannot serialize siblings that share test files; severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated NIT (a deliberate, documented trade-off that bounds run time), while minimax, openai, qwen and z-ai rated MAJOR, so HIGHEST used.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:4316-4376 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When an issue's `prepush_augmented_paths` marker is ignored (4349-4353), or the issue's `files_touched` is empty (`continue` at 4328-4330), the untrusted model-supplied entry is never removed from `recorded`, and it is written back verbatim at 4376 (`data[PREPUSH_AUGMENTED_PATHS_KEY] = recorded`).
  WHY: An unverified marker map is persisted into the decomposition file that `compute-waves --write-back` and `build_tracking_state` consume, and the next augmentation pass reads it again; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point as a hardening suggestion (`recorded.pop(issue_id, None)`).
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:4361-4371 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The augmentation adds the same shared paths to unrelated siblings: `docs/INVENTORY.md`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `tests/inventory_parity.py`, `tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py`, and text-reference tests. `validate_wave_file_partition` (784-873) then reports these as overlaps, and `auto_serialize_file_overlaps` (914-947) injects priority-ordered edges for them.
  WHY: If the model's `dependency_edges` order a newly overlapping pair against priority order, the injected edge closes a cycle (936-946) and raises `OrchestrateError`; `cmd_check_partition` then returns 3 and .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:1155-1159 exits 1, killing an orchestrate run whose decomposition was accepted before this change.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:4346-4353 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_prepush_select_planned_paths` invokes the gate module once per issue (twice for a marker_ignored issue), and each call rescans the whole repository (`list_repo_files`, a text read of every test file, an AST parse per large test file).
  WHY: The run time of the "Validate decomposition JSON" step grows linearly with issue count (schema maxItems 50), and the 60 s per-issue timeout bounds only a hung run, not a slow one; all three reviewers call this a cost note only.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:4425-4426 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The catch-all in `cmd_augment_files_touched` logs a fixed `outcome=skipped reason=internal_error` and drops the exception type.
  WHY: An internal defect, such as a `TypeError` from an unexpected payload, cannot be told apart from a deliberate skip, so the fail-open step degrades silently with nothing for an operator to triage; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point as a hardening suggestion.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:4345-4348 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `issubset` check accepts a model-forged `prepush_augmented_paths` entry that names a planned path (e.g. `tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py` for `scripts/orchestrate_lib.py`), and that path is then dropped from the module's `--paths-file` input.
  WHY: On a second run, tests affected only through the dropped planned path are missed (bounded under-augmentation only, no new attacker capability); downgraded from pass-1's MAJOR.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (Wave 2+ issue creation)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The PR diff for scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh adds the rendering logic for the advisory "Expected files" section but does not invoke augment-files-touched before the poller reads files_touched for Wave 2+ issue bodies. Disputed by anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash: pending_issue_defs is built from the decomposition already augmented in "Validate decomposition JSON" (scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1085-1092 / 1088-1093).
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:augment_files_touched, the "if timed_out:" block (lines ~4331-4335) and "timed_out = reason == 'timeout'" | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Once one issue's selector call times out, every later issue is skipped with reason=timeout_previous, including issues that already have planned files and would finish well within the timeout.
  WHY: Issue #8189 says a timeout means a no-op "for that issue", so later siblings lose their tests and companions and the partition guard cannot serialize them; this is a deliberate, documented departure from the requirement that bounds run time, not a crash.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:augment_files_touched, the per-issue _prepush_select_planned_paths call inside "for issue in data.get('issues', [])", plus the second call in the marker_ignored branch | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The gate module rescans the repository once per issue, and twice for an issue whose marker is ignored.
  WHY: The run time of the "Validate decomposition JSON" step grows linearly with issue count (up to 50), bounded by the 60 s per-issue timeout and the latch; this is a cost note only.
- TASK GAPS: NONE. The reviewer rejects gemini's pass-1 TASK_GAP because pending_issue_defs comes from the already-augmented decomposition (scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1085-1092). It also declines to report the forged marker, since it only makes the augmentation add fewer paths.
- HARDENING (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1, 2 related items): scripts/orchestrate_lib.py augment_files_touched "if marker_ignored:": add `recorded.pop(issue_id, None)`. .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml augment-files-touched invocation: surface the stdout JSON summary as a "PREPUSH_TEST_GATE phase=augment outcome=done added=<n> skipped=<n>" line.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:augment_files_touched function, within the issue loop (around line 4336) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When marker_ignored is true, the recorded dictionary is not updated for the current issue.
  WHY: Invalid or forged entries may stay in the record, which can persist incorrect state across runs.
- TASK_GAP | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  Requirement: "run it on each issue's planned files_touched before the partition guard, compute-waves, the tracking body and pending_issue_defs read files_touched." (Phase P2 of prepush-affected-test-gate-plan.md)
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (Wave 2+ issue creation)
  Evidence of absence: The PR diff for scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh adds the rendering logic for the advisory "Expected files" section but fails to invoke augment-files-touched before the poller reads files_touched for Wave 2+ issue bodies.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:4316-4321, 4349-4353, 4375-4376 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `prepush_augmented_paths` marker is read from model-written JSON into `recorded` and written back verbatim at 4376. The entry is never removed when its marker is ignored and the issue adds nothing, or when the issue's `files_touched` is empty (`continue` at 4328-4330).
  WHY: An unverified map survives into the file that `compute-waves --write-back` and `build_tracking_state` consume, and the next augmentation pass reads it again; the trust check itself (4336-4348) is sound.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:4322, 4331-4335, 4356 (`timed_out = reason == "timeout"`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `timed_out` latch skips every issue after the first timeout without running the module (`reason=timeout_previous`), even though the timeout budget is per issue.
  WHY: This violates "a no-op for that issue": later issues lose their tests and companions (4361-4371 is never reached for them), so check-partition / auto_serialize_file_overlaps let siblings edit the same test file in parallel, and the only trace is a skipped log line.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:4361-4371, with 784-873 (`validate_wave_file_partition`) and 936-946 (`auto_serialize_file_overlaps` cycle raise), triggered from .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:1150-1159 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The augmentation writes shared paths into unrelated siblings: companions from prepush_affected_tests.py:436-446 and registry guards from 395-402. The partition guard treats these as overlaps and injects edges for them.
  WHY: An injected edge that runs against the model's `dependency_edges` closes a cycle and raises `OrchestrateError`; `cmd_check_partition` then returns 3 and orchestrate.yml:1155-1159 exits 1 before the tracking issue is created.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:4425-4426 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The catch-all logs a fixed `outcome=skipped reason=internal_error` and drops the exception type.
  WHY: An internal defect cannot be told apart from a deliberate skip, so the operator has nothing to act on.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:4346, 4353 (`_prepush_select_planned_paths` call per issue) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The gate module runs once per issue and each run rescans the whole repo (`workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:328` `list_repo_files`).
  WHY: The step costs N full repo scans for N issues (up to 50); the timeout bounds only a hung run, and this cost pulls against the `timeout_previous` latch.
- No defect found (3 related items, NIT, confidence 1-2): scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:4280-4296, 4366-4376 (concurrency, atomic `os.replace`, marker idempotence); scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:4596-4604 (naming: additive subcommands, guard exit code 10 test); .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:1105-1111 (trust boundary: module only from the verified support checkout, symlink refused at scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:4387, minimal env).
- TASK GAPS: NONE. All #8189 deliverables were verified, and the poller gap is rejected (scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1088-1093; .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:1480-1499).
- HARDENING (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2, 3 related items): `_prepush_write_json_atomic`,4289 forces 0o644 instead of preserving the file's mode; `augment_files_touched` 4349-4353 should use `recorded.pop(issue_id, None)`; `cmd_augment_files_touched` 4425-4426 should log `error={type(exc).__name__}`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
